notes: All design screens: Home, Menu, workouts (reps, intervals, timers), Weather, Breathe, Food, Voice, Proof, Share, Setup and the mood faces. Touch and swipe to navigate, BOOT = back.
Safer boot settings (no PSRAM, DIO flash) in case the chip failed to start. Same status report over USB every 3 seconds.
Diagnostic: repeats a status report over USB every 3 seconds (stage, memory, I2C devices, power chip) so the Monitor button always shows something.
Diagnostic build: colour test on start, power chip report over USB serial. Flasher page has a Monitor button.
Fixes the black screen: the display was set up with the wrong arguments. POWout UI: Home, Menu, Breathe picker, Calm, Box, 4-7-8.
POWout UI on the AMOLED: Home, Menu, Breathe picker, Calm 4-6, Box 4-4-4-4, 4-7-8. Touch plus BOOT button as back.
First test build: boots and prints its version over USB. No screen UI.
